#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define MAXN 1100000
#define MOD 1000000007

using namespace std;

typedef long long int LL;

LL modpow(LL base, LL exp) {
    LL res = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

bool seen[MAXN];

int main() {
    LL p, K;
    scanf("%I64d%I64d", &p, &K);
    if (K == 0) {
        printf("%I64d\n", modpow(p, p - 1));
        return 0;
    }
    if (K == 1) {
        printf("%I64d\n", modpow(p, p));
        return 0;
    }
    int cycles = 0;
    for (LL i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        if (seen[i]) continue;
        int len = 0;
        LL cur = i;
        while (!seen[cur]) {
            ++len;
            seen[cur] = true;
            cur = (cur * K) % p;
        }
        if (len > 1) ++cycles;
    }
    printf("%I64d\n", modpow(p, cycles));
    return 0;
}
